first-report.1.1.line: {s1-victim} hurries into the lift hall with empty hands, straight from the night kitchen.

first-report.1.2.line: {s1-victim} points {night-stakeout-officer} at the empty floor of lift 2.

first-report.1.3.line: {s1-victim} tells {night-stakeout-officer} {s1-victim.his} takeout bag was snatched in lift 2 a few minutes ago.

first-report.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} runs a handheld scan along the seams of the lift door.

lobby-watch.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the lift hall corner, a paper cup on the ledge, watching the lifts.

lobby-watch.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} reads the lobby log aloud: "03:40, lift 2. 03:12, lift 2. 03:05, lift 2."

lobby-watch.1.3.line: {s1-lobby-guard} leaves the lobby desk empty and walks off down the back corridor.

lobby-watch.1.4.line: {s1-lobby-guard} walks back to the lobby desk eight minutes later and sits down.

wrong-door.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at the lift hall door and waits, a paper bag in hand.

wrong-door.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} calls out, and {red-herring-night-courier} bolts for the stairs with the bag.

wrong-door.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} runs after {red-herring-night-courier} toward the stair door.

wrong-door.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} puts a hand on {rookie-officer}'s arm and holds {rookie-officer.him} at the door.

green-scarf.1.1.line: {s1-victim-b} tells {rookie-officer} the thief had a green scarf and held the bag in the left hand.

green-scarf.1.2.line: {s1-victim-b} points at the lobby screen beside the lift doors.

green-scarf.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the lobby screen still: a figure in a green scarf, stamped "03:40."

bag-at-the-counter.1.1.line: {s1-mugger} waits outside the food counter, a green scarf wadded in one hand.

bag-at-the-counter.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} hands {s1-mugger} a folded paper bag without a word.

bag-at-the-counter.1.3.line: {s1-mugger} carries the paper bag in {s1-mugger.his} left hand into the lift hall.

door-opens.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at tenement door 3B before dawn and waits, bag in hand.

door-opens.1.2.line: {extra:partner} opens door 3B and hugs {red-herring-night-courier} in the doorway.

door-opens.1.3.line: {red-herring-night-courier} lifts flowers and a loaf of bread out of the bag at the door.

scrap-in-the-gap.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} kneels in lift 2 and runs a light along the gap at the floor edge.

scrap-in-the-gap.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} tweezes a torn paper scrap with printed columns out of the gap.

scrap-in-the-gap.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the scrap aloud: "RT," then a column of numbers.

grab-and-arrest.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the lift hall corner again, the paper cup on the same ledge.

grab-and-arrest.1.2.line: {s1-mugger}, a green scarf trailing from one pocket, bumps {extra:resident} at lift 2 and grabs the takeout bag left-handed.

grab-and-arrest.1.3.line: {s1-mugger} runs for the stair door, not the lifts, the bag swinging.

grab-and-arrest.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} steps out at the stair door and pins {s1-mugger} to the wall.

grab-and-arrest.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} pulls a folded paper slip from {s1-mugger}'s left sleeve.

grab-and-arrest.1.6.line: {rookie-officer} unfolds the slip: printed columns of stops and a payday at the bottom.

slip-on-the-desk.1.1.line: {s1-mugger} sits at the interview table, the green scarf in {s1-mugger.his} lap.

slip-on-the-desk.1.2.line: {s1-mugger} tells {rookie-officer} a courier paid {s1-mugger.him} ten credits a run and handed over the slip each Thursday.

slip-on-the-desk.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} lifts a second takeout bag out of the property box.

slip-on-the-desk.1.4.line: {rookie-officer} hands the folded slip to {desk-sergeant} for the case file.

guard-on-the-comm.1.1.line: Comm, one side: "I said stew. Eat the stew."

guard-on-the-comm.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} passes the lobby desk and gives {s1-lobby-guard} a small wave.

guard-on-the-comm.1.3.line: {s1-lobby-guard} stays seated at the lobby desk, comm at {s1-lobby-guard.his} ear, and never leaves for the back corridor.

quiet-lobby.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the lift hall from the corner, cup on the ledge, and no bags are taken.

quiet-lobby.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} hands {s1-victim-b} {s1-victim-b.his} quilted bag back at the lift doors.

quiet-lobby.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the lobby log aloud: "Closed. No new entries."
